## Change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link any relevant issue or owner scope decision.

## Verification

List the source state, commands, and observed results. State untested paths. Keep fixture, unit, installed-browser, and container evidence distinct.

## Review notes

Identify SDK/profile or licensing implications and any remaining limitations. Confirm that reports contain no secrets or private data and that unrelated work is preserved. Do not include CI, publication, or deployment changes without explicit authorization.
